rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the practice or system of serving yourself when buying or obtaining something.

example.english: This supermarket runs on self-service, so you have to pay for your own purchases.
example.traditional: 呢間超市行自助服務，買嘢要自己畀錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 si5 hang4 zi6 zo6 fuk6 mou6 maai5 je5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 bei2 cin4

rows.note: Use this formal term for masturbation as an act or practice.

example.english: The doctor said that self-service, meaning masturbation, is not necessarily harmful.
example.traditional: 醫生話，手淫唔一定對身體有害。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 waa6 sau2 jam4 m4 jat1 ding6 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hoi6
